The story

From Bahrain to Bollywood.

A pageant title became the beginning of a long-running film, fashion and performance career in India.

Born in Manama, Bahrain, Jacqueline Fernandez studied mass communication at the University of Sydney, won Miss Universe Sri Lanka in 2006, and entered Indian cinema with Aladin in 2009.

Born11 August 1985
BirthplaceManama, Bahrain
EducationUniversity of Sydney
DebutAladin · 2009
Career timeline
2006

Miss Universe Sri Lanka

Jacqueline won the national title and represented Sri Lanka at Miss Universe 2006.

2009

Acting debut — Aladin

She moved into film acting with Sujoy Ghosh’s fantasy drama and later received the IIFA Star Debut award.

2011

Breakthrough — Murder 2

The psychological thriller became a defining early commercial success in her career.

2014

Kick

The action entertainer became one of the major commercial successes associated with her Bollywood run.

2016–17

Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa

She joined the ninth season of the dance reality series as a judge.

2022

Vikrant Rona

Her cross-language screen presence expanded with the Kannada action film.

2025

Fateh, Raid 2 & Housefull 5

The supplied archive lists all three among her 2025 film releases.

Beyond the screen

Kindness, animals & people.

Jacqueline’s public charitable work includes animal welfare, food support, COVID relief and community partnerships.

🐾
ANIMAL WELFARE

Standing up for animals

Wikipedia notes Jacqueline’s support for animal-welfare causes and her recognition as PETA India’s “Woman Of The Year” in 2014. She has also spoken publicly against horse-carriage cruelty and supported animal shelters.

Read about her horse-welfare campaign ↗
♡
HELPING PEOPLE IN NEED

YOLO Foundation

In 2021, Jacqueline launched the YOLO Foundation and partnered with organisations including Roti Bank and the Feline Foundation. Reported COVID-relief work included oxygen concentrators, free ambulances, food support and supplies for frontline workers.

Foundation launch & relief work ↗
✦
COMMUNITY

Food, children & community care

Coverage of her foundation’s work also includes meals for people in need, support for children, beach clean-up efforts and partnerships with NGOs serving vulnerable communities.
